overview: Orca Security CNAPP Cloud Security Platform addresses operational records arrive through different systems, supervisors reconstruct evidence manually, and decisions are difficult to audit in cross-industry operations. The first proof of value uses cloud account metadata, identity privileges, workload posture and CVE context. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is critical cloud exposures older than remediation SLA, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.
kpi: critical cloud exposures older than remediation SLA

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: cloud account metadata, identity privileges, workload posture and CVE context; define critical cloud exposures older than remediation SLA and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from IT and platform operations director.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including line-by-line reconciliations against known business transactions.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
deliverables: Agreed test threshold for critical cloud exposures older than remediation SLA
